units.source_text: 收音机广播时时刻刻都传来飓风快到的消息。

en.t: Radio broadcasts were constantly reporting that the typhoon would soon arrive.

units.source_text: 但总是不见飓风到来的迹象。

en.t: But there was still no sign of the typhoon coming.
In the afternoon, the shower stopped.

units.source_text: 明月悬在夜空中，寺庙的人走到庭院里观察气象情况，纷纷议论说，这是暴风雨前夕的沉静。

en.t: A bright moon hung in the night sky, and the people of the temple went out into the garden to observe the weather, saying one after another that this was the calm before the storm.
